definitions: An online marketplace that connects freelancers offering various digital services (gigs) with clients worldwide.
A company that operates the Fiverr platform, facilitating transactions for services typically starting at a base price of five dollars.
examples: She found a graphic designer on Fiverr to create her logo.
Many freelancers use Fiverr to find new clients and projects.
Fiverr has become a popular platform for micro-services.
